description: Source code for a React component named RecommendationGrid used to display a grid of role recommendations with filtering, fetching, and UI behaviors.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, handling undefined or null inputs.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a sanitized array of strings, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range text from role data into numeric min and max values in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the role title from role object fields.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches the current filters based on industry, skills, salary, and title.
